design.name: 邪飞天
design.brief: A corrupted Dunhuang apsara (飞天) support caster floating in the air: a slender celestial dancer with a serene but cracked porcelain-like face and glowing white-gold eyes, a tall golden headdress, long flowing silk ribbons (飘带) that burn at their tips with white-gold fire, bare arms with gold armlets, a cinnabar and malachite green flowing skirt in Dunhuang mural colours, bare feet with five visible toes hanging below. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four slender fingers. Elegant and eerie.
design.weapon: a Chinese pipa (琵琶) held across the body, its tuning pegs glowing white-gold (weak spot)
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions like the jerboa soldier and fire rat of this roster — oversized head with big simple eyes, small simplified nose and mouth, compact body, chunky hands; hair as one solid sculpted shape; ribbons and skirt as thick simple bands; a modest long-sleeved celestial top covering the torso. Toy-like readable forms, not a realistic woman.
